post.summary: Request password recovery with a generic response
post.description: Strict 4 KiB JSON, exact approved HTTPS Origin, identity 3/hour and network 10/hour with 15-minute denial. Unknown, malformed, Google-only and ambiguous SMTP outcomes return the same 202 after accepted limiter processing.

post.summary: Consume a single-use recovery token and reset an existing password credential
post.description: The recovery email links to /recovery_email/{user_id} with the single-use token in the URL fragment. The browser submits it in this JSON body, never in server URLs. When supplied, user_id must match the token owner. Successful reset advances credential/auth epoch and revokes all sessions without issuing a replacement session.
